title: Development touchpoint — prep & follow-ups for Navin Rao
content:
Purpose: quick 30m touchpoint focusing on execution blockers, one coaching topic, and next milestones. Keep it pragmatic — want clear commitments and any escalation points before Friday.

Agenda (30 min)
- 0-5m: personal check-in + energy/focus (how's load, any immediate time off?)
- 5-12m: status on current ticket set (top 3 items) and risks
- 12-20m: unblock deep-dive (perf regression JIRA-4321 + infra changes)
- 20-26m: career coaching (influence and stakeholder mgmt)
- 26-30m: agree actions, timelines, follow-ups

Prep notes (things I want to confirm)
- Navin's estimate on JIRA-4321 fix: originally 3 days, now 1 day remaining? verify what's left (tests, infra rollouts)
- Who needs to sign off for infra change: infra-owner is Mira, but we may need SRE review — get names
- Check if he has enough bandwidth for the refactor spike (PR#987) or needs to defer
- Pulse: is morale OK after last on-call rotation? flagged possible burnout last week.

Top 3 work items (what I expect him to report)
1) JIRA-4321: perf regression on KV cache (severity=P2) — current status, blockers (infra ACL, perf test flakiness), plan to validate in staging
2) PR#987: refactor of batching logic — code review feedback left by Ava (need to address backpressure handling)
3) Feature: streaming-resume stability checks — small rollout metrics (p95 latency, error %), need canary window extended if flappy

Unblock plan (for JIRA-4321)
- Ask whether the failing perf runs are due to test harness or actual regression. If harness, ask for repro steps and schedule 1 hour pairing with SRE.
- If infra ACL stops rollout, escalate to Mira + infra slack thread with proposed rollback plan (target EOD).
- If flakiness persists, propose temporary mitigation: reduce batch-size default for affected endpoint and enable feature-flag rollback.

Coaching topic: influencing across teams
- Goal: help Navin move from deep IC to more cross-team impact. Specific ask: next week propose a short design note for the refactor (1 page) that calls out dependency impact and rollout plan; aim to solicit feedback from infra and SRE up front.
- Roleplay prompts: "How would you explain the risk to Mira?" "What's the smallest request you can make that gets buy-in?"
- Suggest practice: copy one infra owner into the PR description and ping on Slack with a one-sentence ask.

Feedback to give (gentle, actionable)
- Positive: cleaned up telemetry in PR#974 was excellent (called out metrics clearly).
- Area: be more proactive with PR descriptions — include rollout steps and monitoring checklist.

Questions for Navin
- Are you comfortable owning the infra rollout coordination or do you want me to take the lead?
- What would make the PR review process faster for you (templates, checklist, dedicated reviewer)?
- Are there non-obvious downstream consumers of the batching change we should call out?

Notes to self
- If he seems overloaded, push the refactor spike off one sprint and scope thin MVP.
- If burnout flag reappears, schedule a longer 1:1 and pull LPM for workload redistribution.
- Remember: follow up with Ava on her final review items (she's listed two blocking comments).

Proposed action items (decide in meeting and write here)
- Navin: run isolated perf harness to reproduce regression and post logs to JIRA-4321 by 2027-08-24 EOD (owner: Navin, due: 2027-08-24)
- Me (Riley): if still failing, create infra slack thread and add Mira + SRE oncall (owner: Riley, due: 2027-08-24 EOD)
- Navin: update PR#987 description with rollout steps and monitoring checklist; request Ava as reviewer and ping infra (owner: Navin, due: 2027-08-25)
- Both: schedule 1 hour pairing session with SRE for perf test flakiness (owner: Navin+Riley, target: 2027-08-25)

Follow-up reminders
- I will check JIRA-4321 tomorrow morning before standup and escalate if no progress.
- Add a short blurb to the team channel summarizing mitigation if we flip the feature flag.

Quick links (to paste in meeting)
- JIRA-4321: https:\/\/redwood.atlassian.net\/browse\/JIRA-4321
- PR#987: https:\/\/github.com\/redwoodinc\/inference\/pull\/987
- Perf harness notes (confluence): confluence://kg-team/plan-q3

Tone / reminders for meeting
- Keep it collaborative, not accusatory. Focus on next steps, not blame.
- Use concrete asks (timeboxed pairing, specific deliverables).
- End with explicit commitments and calendar invites for follow-ups.

End of doc — will update action items after 1:1
